@@info: Prefer translating in your browser? Fink edits messages/ru.json directly — no code or git:
This file is the offline alternative.
Keys that exist in <en> but not in <ru>.
The values below are the en source text — replace them with ru translations.
You do not have to translate all of them; leave out what you are unsure about and open a PR.
A maintainer then runs 'npm run i18n:apply' to merge this file into messages/ru.json.
Anything still missing afterwards simply renders in en at runtime.
Plurals — ru uses the forms: one, few, many, other. "other" is required.
(add "plural": "total" to count another input instead of {count}).
Inside a sentence, # is the number: "Read {count, plural, one {# band} other {# bands}}"
An exact number like "=0": "No bands" beats the forms above.
equalizer_autoeq_select_source_and_targe: Please select both a source device and target curve.
equalizer_autoeq_data_not_found: Source or target data not found.
equalizer_autoeq_no_response_data: Could not retrieve frequency response data.
equalizer_player_device_eq: {device} applies the EQ, so this player leaves it off.
equalizer_player_device_eq_unwritten: It doesn't hold your latest changes yet.
equalizer_player_device_ask: Listening through {device}? Then the EQ is applied twice.
equalizer_player_device_eq_there: Leave the EQ to the device
eq_hold_on_device: Holding \ can't switch the EQ while {device} is applying it.
